# Payment to QR

> Free, open source generator for NBS IPS QR codes. Photograph a Serbian payment
> slip, invoice or bill, check the extracted fields, and get a QR code you can
> scan in any Serbian banking app.

Payment to QR converts a payment document into an NBS IPS QR payload. It does
not move money, hold funds, connect to a bank, or ask for credentials. Your
banking app performs the payment after you review and confirm it there.

The project is unofficial and independent. It is not affiliated with or endorsed
by the National Bank of Serbia (Narodna banka Srbije).

## How it works

1. Photograph a payment slip (uplatnica), invoice, bill or screenshot.
2. Text is extracted — by default with OCR that runs in your browser, so the
   image never leaves your device. An optional Claude vision extractor is more
   accurate but sends the image to a server, and is off by default.
3. The extracted fields appear in a form. Fields the extractor was unsure about
   are flagged for review. This step cannot be skipped.
4. The payment is validated, including the account's mod 97-10 control digits.
5. A scannable IPS QR code is rendered — but only once validation passes.

## Key facts

- Licence: MIT. Free to use, modify and self-host.
- Price: free. There is no paid tier, account, or signup.
- Privacy: default extraction is on-device. Nothing is stored or logged.
- Two implementations of the same specification: TypeScript (`src/core`) and
  Python (`python/ips_qr`), with mirrored test suites.
- The Python package installs a CLI: `ips-qr --pdf racun.pdf --png qr.png`.
- Scripts: Serbian Cyrillic and Latin are both handled, including documents
  that mix them on one page.
- Known limitation: generated codes are not verified against the official NBS
  validator, and OCR on photographed slips is unreliable — which is precisely
  why a human review step exists.

## Offline and installation

It is a progressive web app and can be installed to a phone's home screen.

- Typing a payment in and generating a QR code works with no connection at all.
- Reading a slip with on-device OCR works offline after one scan made while
  online, which is when the language data is downloaded and cached.
- The optional Claude vision extractor always requires a connection.

Nothing is downloaded speculatively; the language data arrives only if you scan.

## The payload format

An IPS QR code is a flat, pipe-separated string of tagged fields:

K:PR|V:01|C:1|R:265000123456789098|N:Elektrodistribucija Beograd|I:RSD3450,00|SF:189

K identification code, V version, C character set, R recipient account (18
digits), N recipient name, I amount, P payer name, SF payment code, S purpose,
RO reference model and number.
